_purpose: Pin for garble, which obfuscates only the Winn client engines that ship from winsvpn.org (owner ruling 2026-10-27). Kept out of tools/toolchain-pins.json so the reviewed pins that bind that file's digest stay unchanged.

garble.note: Obfuscates only the Winn client engines that ship from winsvpn.org (owner ruling 2026-10-27). v0.18.0 (2026-09-19) is the first garble release supporting Go 1.27. Built on 2026-10-27 with the pinned Go: GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS='-trimpath -buildvcs=false' CGO_ENABLED=0 go install mvdan.cc/garble@v0.18.0 (no -buildid= strip: garble keys its cache on its own Go build ID and panics without one); two builds with separate empty caches were byte-identical.
